verdict.rationale: Ironclad's Workflow Designer and Workflow APIs support configurable, publishable approval workflows that gate contracts prior to signature, with integrations able to 'automatically block or push forward approvals' and launch workflows via API/UI. Core capability is well-documented across multiple first-party docs, but missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of approval-routing specifically (community evidence covers other aspects, not workflow approvals) and no detail on approval-step configuration UI beyond admin-controlled Workflow Designer.
